item.title: Nghimtina a dhimbulukiwa ongependafule
item.description: OONGWEDIVA – Minista omukulu gwiiyenditho niilonga Erkki Nghimtina okwa hulitha mepupi lyomimvo 77 mOsoondaha. Nghimtina okwa yambukile momukunda Eembidi, moshitopolwa shaHangwena.
